# CANDIDATE: BASELINE_STAGE1_VALIDATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are running a Stage-1 backtest on the base engine (no changes) to validate the edge_capture on J anchor days, out-of-sample Sharpe, and real-fills performance on the top-3 J days. This serves as a baseline for future candidates.

## Mechanism

No changes to the engine. We run the Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder harness on the current engine configuration (as of the latest params.json and heartbeat.md) to compute:
- edge_capture on J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04, 5/05, 5/06, 5/07)
- out-of-sample Sharpe (using walk-forward or held-out window as per the grinder)
- real-fills validation on the top-3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) by comparing BS-sim to real OPRA fills.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (based on risk-rules.md and playbook.md)
2. **Sample bias:** We are using the base engine configuration as of the latest commit. The sample is the entire available history (approx 16 months) for the grinder. Overfit risk is mitigated by the Stage-1 gates (floors, concentration, quarter-coverage) but we are only reporting Stage-1 results here.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (we will run the grinder and report the OOS Sharpe from the walk-forward or held-out window)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (we will run the real-fills validation on the top-3 J days as part of the Stage-1 backtest)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/07 (two losers) could lead to losses if the engine takes the wrong side. Max drawdown: unknown without full backtest. Blow-up scenario: if the engine takes large losing positions on multiple consecutive days.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (we will compute top5_pct from the Stage-1 backtest)
